messages:
Maya: Heads-up — during the token-routing v2 canary we observed project-scoped requests falling back to org tokens under load, which blew past project quotas. Snippet from the proxy logs:
```
level=warn route=auth-routing req_id=abcd123 origin=project:proj-42 token_used=org:org-7 fallback=true reason=affinity_mismatch
```
This began ~14:30 UTC when traffic ramped to 70%.

Jun: Oof. Which policy change rolled? the last PR touched affinity ordering, right? Can you paste the routing blob we pushed?

Maya: Pasting the policy we rolled to canary (sanitized):
```
[
  {\"match\": \"token_type == \\\"service_account\\\"\", \"prefer\": \"sticky_affinity\"},
  {\"match\": \"origin == \\\"project\\\"\", \"prefer\": \"computed_affinity\"},
  {\"match\": \"*\", \"prefer\": \"org_fallback\"}
]
```
Note the computed_affinity path is async and sometimes returns null under high concurrency, which triggers org_fallback.

Riley: Quick mitigation idea: short-circuit fallback if request includes explicit origin header (`x-origin=project:<id>`) and honor that for N seconds for that key. i.e. prefer header-affinity over computed. Cheap to implement at gateway.

Alex: Agreed. Also add a telemetry counter for when origin header != token origin so we can measure frequency. Suggest metric names: `auth.origin_mismatch.count` and tag by `origin_type` + `fallback_reason`.

Jun: We should also surface this in Console (per-request timeline). A small UX change: on the API request detail pane show `claimed_origin` vs `effective_token` with a callout when they differ and a link to revoke or rotate the token.

Maya: Proposed rollout plan: 1) immediate gateway hotfix (prefer x-origin header) as a 5% canary, 2) emit origin_mismatch metric, 3) small Console flag behind feature-flag, 4) revert policy if we see no improvement.

Riley: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4217 — hotfix changes in `gateway/auth_router.go` + unit tests.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for PR 4217 @ 2799987700 — route: 5% traffic to gateway-canary.

Alex: I'll add the metric in telemetry infra and a Grafana alert if origin_mismatch.rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m.

Jun: If hotfix looks good after 30m, we can roll to 50% then 100%. Also make a runbook entry: callout when project quota usage spikes while origin_mismatch high.

Maya: Thanks. I'm leaving a prod trace on the most recent affected request (req_id=abcd123). I'll DM the owners for quota adjustments if needed. :eyes:

Riley: :thumbsup: merging and watching.

Alex: Filing the Console UX ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/UX-900 show token origin mismatch in request timeline.

Maya: Closing loop — if anyone sees new anomalies ping me directly.

Jun: Nice quick turnaround, team. :shipit:
